policy: Every high or critical advisory fails CI. An entry here is only accepted while the advisory has no patched release and the documented expiry has not passed; the gate re-checks the advisory and fails as soon as upstream publishes a fix, so no exception survives a real upgrade. Currently no exception is needed: picomatch GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf is no longer reported by npm audit and effect GHSA-7589-6fvf-x4pw is patched via the effect override in the root package.json.
